Most common steps in such cycle involve- recognizing a problem, defining it, developing a strategy in order to fix it, organizing knowledge and resources available, monitoring progress, and evaluating the effectiveness of the solution. Once a solution is obtained, another problem usually comes, and the cycle starts again. Searching techniques in problem-solving by using artificial intelligence (A.I) are surveyed in this paper. An overview of definitions, development and dimensions of A.I in the light of search for solutions to problems are accepted. Dimensions as well as relevance of search in A.I research is reviewed. A classification of searching in the matter of depth of known parameters of search was also investigated. At last, the forethoughts of searching in AI research are brought into prominence. Search is noticed that it is the common thread that binds most of the problem-solving strategies in AI together.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.32628/ijsrset22962\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2022, 11, 1]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.7610838\", \"title\": [\"Autonomous Thermal Engineering: Integration of Digital Twins, Artificial Intelligence, and Advanced Heat Transfer Mechanisms for Sustainable Energy Systems\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Thermal engineering systems are increasingly facing challenges associated with dynamic operating conditions, energy efficiency demands, and the transition toward sustain…

The architecture com-bines hypothesis generation, causal reasoning, falsification, formal verification, andpersistent orchestration through a shared memory state that records assumptions,counterexamples, interventions, and proof obligations. By treating failed predictionsand invalid proof attempts as useful learning signals, the framework shifts discoveryfrom fluent claim production toward disciplined claim survival.
